name: MMVPR Challenge
description: We present an effective approach for adapting the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) to the Visual Object Tracking (VOT) task. Our method leverages the powerful pre-trained capabilities of SAM2 and incorporates several key techniques to enhance its performance in VOT applications. By combining SAM2 with our proposed optimizations, we achieved a first place AUC score of 89.4 on the 2024 ICPR Multi-modal Object Tracking challenge, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. This paper details our methodology, the specific enhancements made to SAM2, and a comprehensive analysis of our results in the context of VOT solutions along with the multi-modality aspect of the dataset.
reputation: A competition-style benchmark with strong challenge visibility in the tracking community, especially around ICPR challenge entries.
notes: Challenge benchmark; reported score is from a specific competition setup and may not generalize across datasets or evaluation protocols.
